hero.description: Reserve Seventh-day Adventist books from any church in Rwanda. Confirmation is fast and pickup is easy.

about.title: Simplifying Church Book Access in Rwanda
about.p1: Many people found it difficult to buy church books. Before, you had to go to the conference office, wait for someone to bring the books to your church, or ask church leaders to order them for you. This took time and was not easy for everyone.
about.p2: SDA Booking was created to make this process simple. With our system, you can book the church books you need from anywhere in Rwanda using your phone or computer.
about.p3: After your booking is confirmed, you can pick up your books at the church you attend or at another church location you choose. This makes buying church books faster, easier, and more convenient for everyone.
about.benefit1: No more traveling to conference offices
about.benefit2: Order from anywhere using your phone
about.benefit3: Pick up at your local church
